posts.name: Envisioner
posts.cooked:
Oh boy, rough start we're off to here.  I discard External Combustion.  I'll voluntarily take the Jinx since my opening hand isn't set up for much damage-dealing; I'll focus on being The Tank for this match since Haka, Legs and Scholar aren't around.  (Considering he literally is a tank, Bunker doesn't get to play the role very often, so this will be a nice change of pace from his usual More Dakka for me.)

Bunker

HP: 25

Hand:  Auxiliary Power Source, Decommissioned Hardware, Omni-Cannon.

In Play: 

Trash:  External Combustion

--------------------------------------------------------

Start of Turn:

Play a Card: Auxiliary Power Source.

Use a Power:  Auxiliary Power Source.  Draw Maintenance Unit, Ammo Drop, Gatling Gun.

Draw a Card:  Recharge Mode.

End of Turn:

-------------------------------------------------------

HP: 25

Hand:  Decommissioned Hardware, Omni-Cannon, Maintenance Unit, Ammo Drop, Gatling Gun, Recharge Mode.

In Play:

Trash: External Combustion, Auxiliary Power Source.

Effects: Target of Scattered Mind jinx - whenever Bunker deals damage, their player must discard 1 card.  Tempest, CR, you're the Lancers.

posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
At that point it is a gamble more on where you are more likely to cross the 5 damage threshold.

In this game Imminent Destruction is a threat (projectile) Primordial, and T-Rex can one shot components if Omni goes temporal and becomes highest HP hero by avoiding all the little damages.

The psychic damage is only likely to cross 5 damage if things get really bad or on Kismet's flip side if Talisman is mismanaged.
